Neighbor Daniel:
You can't plant any seeds now, neighbor. You already planted all the land you plowed.


823     
Neighbor Daniel:
It's too early to harvest your crop, neighbor. Why don't you wait until it's completely ripe?


824    "NoPlant6"
Neighbor Daniel: 
It's too early to plow or plant your fields, neighbor. The ground is still frozen. Why don't you wait until April, when the ground thaws?

826

999.name: Hints
999.text:
2,10,11,16,18,22
Click on the squares you want to plow. Each square
represents 20 acres. Decide how many workers to hire
by clicking on the arrows in the Workers box. To start 
plowing, click on OK. To leave the fields without plowing,
click on Cancel. Tip: In the spring try to finish plowing
your fields by the end of May, before the heavy summer
rains start and the ground becomes too muddy for plowing.
In the fall, try to finish plowing before the first frost,
which comes in early October.
Once you have finished plowing your field, decide which 
seeds to plant. Make sure that you have bought enough 
seeds before you start planting. To plant, drag the seeds
 from the Seeds in Storage to the square you want to plant.
To start planting, click on OK. 
To leave the field without planting, click on Cancel.

Decide how many workers to hire by clicking on the arrows
 in the Workers box. Tip: Try to finish harvesting winter wheat 
in time to prepare your fields for planting summer crops. 
Try to finish harvesting summer crops in time to prepare
 your fields for planting winter wheat.

1000.name: NoPlow1
1000.text: There are enough things to do here. You don't have to plow the fields twice and make extra work for yourself.

1001.name: NoPlow2
1001.text: You planted some crops that you haven't harvested yet. If you plow now, you will destroy all your hard work.

1002.name: NoPlow3
1002.text: The land is frozen. If you plow now, you could break your plow. It's better to wait until spring.

1003.name: Noplow4
1003.text: The land is very muddy from all the rain. The plow will sink in the mud. It's better to wait until fall.

1004.name: NoPlow5
1004.text: Hello, neighbor. I'm glad to see you. It's not time to plant yet. First, you should harvest the last crop that you planted.

1005.name: NoPlow6
1005.text: I'm waiting for you to sell me your crops. I'll give you a good price.

1006.name: FDBK7
1006.text: Great. Now that you finished plowing,                 you can start planting.

1007.name: StopPlow1
1007.text: The summer rains started before you finished  plowing. You have to stop plowing now. Your fields are all muddy.

1008.name: StopPlow2
1008.text: The ground froze before you finished plowing. You have to stop plowing now. It's starting to snow.

1009.name: StopPlow3
1009.text:
Your plow broke. The land is very hard in this area. What are you going to do?

      1.  Buy a new steel right away for $50.

      2.  Fix the old plow for free, 
           which takes a few days.

1010.name: StopPlow4
1010.text: One of your horses is sick. Now you can use only one horse, so your plowing will take twice as long.

1011.name: NoMoney
1011.text:
I'm sorry. You don't have enough cash
                    to buy a new plow.

1012.name: NoPlant1
1012.text: You don't have any seeds. Drop by the store to order some. You can look at our catalog which shows the seeds you can buy and the plants you can grow from them.

1013.name: NoPlant2
1013.text: Soon the hot summer sun will beat down on your fields and dry out your seeds. If I were you, I would plow my land before I plant those seeds.

1014.name: NoPlant3
1014.text: If you don't plow your land soon, the winds will scatter most of your seeds. Those seeds will grow, but not necessarily on your land.

1015.name: NoPlant4
1015.text: Hello, neighbor. I'm glad to see you. It's not time to plant yet. First, you should harvest the last crop that you planted.

1016.name: NoPlant5
1016.text: I think the seed catalog suggested a different season for planting those seeds. If I were you, I would check the catalog.

1017.name: NoHarv1
1017.text: Have patience, my friend. Give your plants enough time to grow before you harvest them.

1018.name: NoHarv2
1018.text: My friend, you have to plant before you can harvest.You can't get something from nothing.

1019.name: NoHarv3
1019.text: Hello there, neighbor. I see that you still have a bit to learn about farming. You can't harvest your fields before you've even plowed them and planted some seeds.

1020.name: Tractor
1020.text: There aren't enough tractors for all of us. Make sure that you have a tractor for each worker you hire.

1021.name: OneWor
1021.text: I'm sorry. You don't have enough money to pay me. I can't work for you if you can't pay me.

1022.name: ManyWor
1022.text: I'm sorry. You don't have enough money to pay us. We can't work for you if you can't pay us.

1023.name: StopHarv1
1023.text: The summer rains started early this year. They destroyed the rest of your crops. There's no point in harvesting them now.

1024.name: StopHarv2
1024.text: Winter came early this year. The first frost killed the rest of your crops. There's no point in harvesting them now.

1025.name: NoBuild
1025.text: You need more money to do this.

1027.name: GoBank
1027.text: Go to the bank to collect your money.

1028.name: QText
1028.text:
Click on the squares you want to plow. Each square
represents 20 acres. Decide how many workers to hire
by clicking on the arrows in the Workers box. To start 
plowing, click on OK. To leave the fields without plowing,
click on Cancel. Tip: In the spring try to finish plowing
your fields by the end of May, before the heavy summer
rains start and the ground becomes too muddy for plowing.
In the fall, try to finish plowing before the first frost,
which comes in early October.

1029.name: FDB18
1029.text: You were lucky. The summer rains started late this year. Your horse recovered and you finished plowing before the rain started.

1030.name: FDBK19
1030.text: You were lucky this time. The horses recovered and you finished plowing before the snow started.

1031.name: NoPlant7
1031.text:
You can't plant any seeds now, neighbor.
You've already planted all the land you plowed.

1032.name: NoPlant6
1032.text: It's too early to plow or plant your fields, neighbor. The ground is still frozen. Why don't you wait until April, when the ground thaws?

1033.name: NoPlant8
1033.text: I wouldn't plow or plant in the middle of summer, neighbor. The seeds won't grow well now.

1034.text: Do you want to save your work?

1035.name: FDBK
1035.text:
Your plow broke. The land is very hard in this area. What are you going to do?

      1.  Buy a new steel right away for $50.

      2.  Fix the old plow for free, 
           which takes a few days.

1041.name: EndHarv
1041.text: Now that you've harvested your crops, it's time to sell them. I'll make you an  offer you can't refuse.

1042.name: EndHarv1
1042.text: Now that you've harvested your crops, it's time to sell them. I'll make you an  offer you can't refuse.

1121.name: CurFDBK
1121.text: I think the seed catalog suggested a different season for planting those seeds. If I were you, I would check the catalog.
